title: Ben Rich: Skunk Works considered burying stealth

tellings.quote: we considered actually burying the whole thing. I mean, before we even got started.

plain: In the 1970s, Lockheed's secret aircraft design shop, the Skunk Works, was working on stealth, meaning planes built to be very hard to spot on radar. An aviation writer named Nick Cook told podcast host Jesse Michels that Ben Rich, who led the Skunk Works, said the team thought about burying the whole idea before they even got started. If true, it suggests that a breakthrough technology was nearly kept hidden by the people who found it.
